SticsREval

SticsREval evaluates a candidate version of the STICS crop model against field observations and a reference version:

  • statistical evaluation (evaluate()): global, per-species and per-USM comparison of the candidate version with the reference;
  • balance closure test (balance_closure_test()): consistency of the water and nitrogen balances;
  • HTML dashboard (render_report()) to browse the results.

See the Get started vignette for the full workflow and the reference for each function’s arguments.

Installation 

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("SticsRPacks/SticsREval")

To restore the exact dependency versions recorded in renv.lock after cloning the repository, run renv::restore().

render_report() also requires the Quarto CLI, which is not an R package and must be installed separately (it is included in the Docker image).

Example 

library(SticsREval)

# Build a STICS workspace from the SMS repository
gen_workspace_from_sms(
  sms_path   = "/path/to/sms_repository",
  stics_path = "/path/to/stics_distribution",
  output_dir = "workspace/"
)

# Run the reference and candidate versions
run_simulations(
  stics_exe      = "/path/to/stics_reference",
  usms_workspace = "workspace/",
  metadata_file  = "metadata.csv",
  output_dir     = "reference/"
)
run_simulations(
  stics_exe      = "/path/to/stics_candidate",
  usms_workspace = "workspace/",
  metadata_file  = "metadata.csv",
  output_dir     = "outputs/"
)

# Evaluate the candidate version and render the dashboard
evaluate(
  usms_workspace = "workspace/",
  sim_rds        = "outputs/simulations.rds",
  obs_rds        = "outputs/observations.rds",
  ref_sim_rds    = "reference/simulations.rds",
  output_dir     = "outputs/",
  report         = TRUE
)

Docker

A pre-built image, including the Quarto CLI, is available on the GitHub Container Registry:

docker pull ghcr.io/sticsrpacks/stics-r-eval:v0.1.1

# Interactive R session
docker run --rm -it -v /path/to/your/workspace:/workspace \
  ghcr.io/sticsrpacks/stics-r-eval:v0.1.1 R

# Non-interactive script
docker run --rm -v /path/to/your/workspace:/workspace \
  -v /path/to/your/script.R:/script.R \
  ghcr.io/sticsrpacks/stics-r-eval:v0.1.1 Rscript /script.R

To build it locally (a GitHub token is needed to install private SticsRPacks dependencies):

docker build --secret id=GITHUB_TOKEN,src=<(echo $GITHUB_PAT) -t stics-r-eval .

Related packages

  • SticsRFiles: read/write STICS input and output files
  • SticsOnR: run STICS simulations from R
